# The Package Discription
This package is used for compiling multiple R functions. To see them in use please refer to the the rmd file "PackagesRMDCalls" in the previous folder. 

There are multiple functions, each has their own data and descriptions. Finally, there is one piece of data embedded in the package (DDT.csv).
